data.description: Per-element image-comparison slider. Markup expects two stacked images (or any nodes) inside the container, and an optional pair of label children.

data-aed-ba-start.description: Initial reveal position 0–100 (% of width shown for the 'after' image).

data.description: Optional labels rendered as small badges over the image. Place inside the container.

data-aed-ba-label.description: Which side this label belongs to. Text content of the element becomes the badge text.
